errors.evidence: The initial accuracy for the MFDSL (red) curve is approximately 81.9%, as it is visibly below the 82.0% grid line. Stating it is approximately 82.0% is an inaccurate rounding.

For the MFDSL (red) curve, the most significant slowdown in the rate of increase occurs after dimension 50. While the curve continues to flatten, stating that it stabilizes at dimension 100 is an over-generalization that misses the more prominent trend change point at dimension 50.
